process_roles.driver: 3 independent sequential synthetic sessions; no DB or application imports
process_roles.intake: one source workspace/sole-writer process; 4 DB connections; three concurrent requests; synthetic identify lease acquisition retained here as an explicit approximation
process_roles.worker: two actual source worker loops in one separate process; 3 DB connections
process_roles.observer: independent process; 1 serialized DB connection; 10 ms sleep plus query duration

deployment_inference: photo/workspace share one functionName; cron and identify each differ. Supports separate worker/intake model; does not prove instance placement, enablement of Fluid, CPU isolation or actual concurrency. Identify process separation is not modeled.

metric_boundaries.lease_ms: intake-role call to acquire transaction through completion; excludes IPC
metric_boundaries.photo_verify_ms: unchanged sum of two parallel in-memory metadata elapsed operations
metric_boundaries.photo_wall_ms: earliest verifyPhoto entry through latest verifyPhoto completion, monotonic span; excludes upload
metric_boundaries.save_ack_ms: workspace source handler invocation through response in intake role; excludes driver IPC
metric_boundaries.save_tx_ms: actual sole-writer transaction after controlled barrier
metric_boundaries.queue_lock_ms: actual save queue-lock query elapsed; lease queue spans separately retained
metric_boundaries.driver_save_roundtrip_ms: IPC request/response wall diagnostic only, not substituted for save_ack_ms
